source_provenance.limitation: The published frozen_be54300 source contains restoration.py and its exact crop/_inpaint core but does not contain completion_frontend.py or run_semantic_completion_frontend_benchmark.py, and lacks the later inpaint_region wrapper. Current local copies are hash-bound, but this audit does not establish that those whole files are byte-identical to the 2026-08-28 execution source. Historical saved masks/completions independently verify U=O&support, outside-U copying, whole-O PSNR, and coverage/precision for all 185 outputs. Do not claim the complete 37-case generation program is archived as frozen_be54300.

counterexample.meaning: Coverage decreased while PSNR increased: association is not pointwise monotonic or a proven isolated cause.

original37.original_CI_vs_later_audit: The original paired CSV uses metric-specific seeds derived from 20260828. The later published routing audit reports a different seed-20261008 CI; do not combine their endpoints.

expanded253.scope: Routing and controlled request-mask handoff only; no expanded LaMa/PSNR experiment. Two historical upstream candidate pools with common frozen postprocessing/grouping.

safe_claims: Observed HPID-minus-raw mean whole-defect PSNR is -0.743067 dB, with the original paired 95% interval crossing zero.

HPID covers less of the known defect on average in these 37 cases. Unrequested damaged pixels are copied from the corrupted image, which is a direct scoring mechanism, but coverage is not a sufficient or monotonic explanation of the PSNR difference.
LaMa receives only the cropped image and binary mask. IDs/semantic query are used in upstream target selection; semantic_name is not passed to the neural model.
Crop is based on U bbox with integer padding max(12, round(0.22*max(width,height))), clipped to image boundaries; changing U may change model context as well as filled area.
Request precision relative to known O is 1 for every nonempty request by intersection construction, not semantic precision.
The 253-request extension adds routing/mask-handoff evidence, not new completion quality evidence.
unsupported_claims: The identity contract damages the generative prior.
The lower PSNR is causally or entirely explained by lower coverage.
A more semantically precise request necessarily produces worse LaMa output.
The backend sees persistent IDs or text prompts.
Request precision 1 demonstrates semantic selection correctness.
LaMa was exactly deterministic on all 37 repeated generations.
The full 37-case generation source is identical to the archived frozen_be54300 tree.
